name: new_bench_tags
description: new_bench_tags is a dataset from the RAG4Math project that provides tagging/labeling for math problems to support retrieval-augmented workflows. It measures a model's ability to assign correct topic/tags or categories to mathematical questions, which helps retrieval systems select relevant documents or solutions. The benchmark focuses on accurate classification of math problem attributes rather than solution generation.
reputation: A specialized dataset used within the RAG4Math/retrieval-augmented math community; modest adoption outside that niche.
